scientific_question: Does a molecular-trained frozen ENPDA-Core retain a causal proposal advantage on non-molecular social-graph topology?

pair_construction.target_node_permutation: independent deterministic permutation per source graph
pair_construction.exact_optimum_argument: the planted map preserves every target edge, while no common edge subgraph can contain more edges than the target graph

evaluation.model_training_domain: AIDS, MOLHIV, and MCF-7 molecular graph pairs only
evaluation.primary_metric: edge accuracy against the analytic planted optimum

statistics.primary: paired graph bootstrap with independent resampling of three frozen training seeds
